description: This bar chart, from the paper “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models,” illustrates the effect sizes for two models, XLM-B₂ (represented by red bars) and a baseline model (represented by pink bars), across three morphosyntactic categories: “gender,” “tag,” and “tense.” The horizontal axis displays these categories, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” measures the magnitude of the effect on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 25, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements. For the “gender” category, the pink bar reaches approximately 17.5, while the red bar is slightly higher, around 18.5. In the “tag” category, the pink bar is approximately 12.5 and the red bar is slightly lower, around 12. For “tense,” both bars are very short, with the pink bar at approximately 1.5 and the red bar at approximately 1. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner, clearly distinguishing the pink bars as representing the baseline model and the red bars as representing XLM-B₂. The bars are sorted in descending order of effect size within each category, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
